45/S0.subgoal: Describe the definition and requirements of an empirical usability study.

45/S1.subgoal: Describe the four stages of an empirical research study.

45/S2.subgoal: Illustrate the limitations of subjective and non-testable research questions using a GUI case study.

45/S3.subgoal: Describe how to formulate testable questions that allow for objective data collection using a case study.

45/S4.subgoal: Explain how to balance the trade-off between testable and generalized questions by framing multiple research questions.

45/S5.subgoal: Describe how to identify independent and dependent variables in an empirical study.

45/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
